items.title: Microsoft says AI didn’t break Outlook — its own network upgrade did
items.summary: No one has confirmed what caused the Microsoft outage that took down Outlook and Copilot, and nothing links it to layoffs or AI, but it's not the first time Microsoft's own changes broke its apps.

items.title: SpaceX Hollows Out Its AI Video Division. Elon Musk Now Has Different Priorities
items.summary: A quiet round of layoffs just gutted one of Elon Musk's flashiest AI products, months after he vowed to double down on it. The retreat could hand a rival with deep pockets and a giant video platform exactly the opening it needs.

items.title: The Chaos and Unexpected Joys of a 19-Hour Global Email Outage

items.title: Microsoft Service Restored After Widespread Outage, Company Says

items.title: CoreWeave Jumped 20% and Pulled Oracle Higher. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysOracle sold $20 billion of stock and bonds days after capping new capital-market funding at that amount through fiscal 2030. Bloomberg reported that Microsoft is winding down a 2023 deal to rent AI computing from Oracle on older Nvidia chips.
